pr_title: Use Shared IRQ for stm32 ADC driver
pr_body:
I added the ability to use a shared IRQ for the stm32 ADC driver to allow devices with just a single ADC IRQ to use all channels.

Edit: This is my first PR, please let me know if I need to make any changes. Thanks!

Fixes #26874
pr_comments: Looks like the failures are due to the configurable prescalar change. I will take a look later when I have time
I was reading the contribution guidelines and I missed a few things, such as the commit signoff. I will fix that soon.
I fixed the styling issues that caused the compliance checks to fail before. I also veried it with the checkpatch script before pushing it.

> Then, have you been able to test these changes ?

We have a custom board using the stm32f407 and I have tested using multiple ADC's together and it is working.
@erwango I made the changes you requested
@mbolivar-nordic Adding a line at the end of file drivers/adc/Kconfig.stm32 caused the compliance check to fail. Do you want me to remove it again?

> Adding a line at the end of file drivers/adc/Kconfig.stm32 caused the compliance check to fail. Do you want me to remove it again?

This can be a bit tricky, but there is a difference between "newline at end of file" and "empty line at end of file".

I'm asking for "newline at end of file", which means that the last byte in the file is a newline character. What is in there right now is "empty line at end of file", which is **two** newline characters.

> I'm asking for "newline at end of file", which means that the last byte in the file is a newline character. What is in there right now is "empty line at end of file", which is **two** newline characters.

Okay, thanks for clarifying that. I have removed the extra new line

issue_context.title: STM32: Multiple ADCs using same interrupt not possible
comments: This enhancement would be great!  @lsangild how did you end up dealing with this limitation?

> This enhancement would be great! @lsangild how did you end up dealing with this limitation?

I have not dealt with it. My application does not necessarily need the dedicated inputs at the moment, so I am using only ADC1.
Later on in the development process, if this feature is not implemented, I will probably use the HAL or LL libraries to circumvent the limitations present in Zephyr.
@lsangild @erwango   Hi, do you have solve this question?  or any ideas about it

> @Jeepgoing please check #37585

LGTM

```
#ifdef CONFIG_ADC_STM32_SHARED_IRQS
static bool init_irq = true;
#endif
```

But i am not sure is the best solution. i am thinking dma mode do by myself. @erwango

review_comments: Would it be cleaner if `init_irq` is statically declared in this function, which would be initalized to false by default and calling this function would set it to true? @erwango
If we want this piece of code to be executed only once, we have to rely on a global variable, imo.
